interface.shortDescription: Spring Boot scaffold, DevOps, testing, observability, and article-writing skills for Kimi Code CLI.
interface.longDescription: A skill pack for building and shipping production-ready Spring Boot / Java backends. Includes spring-scaffold for bootstrapping convention-compliant projects, devops-scaffold for Docker and CI, spring-testing for Testcontainers and Boot 4 test APIs, otel-setup for OpenTelemetry end-to-end, and article for drafting long-form technical pieces in your voice.
